data.name: Hotel Cumbres Lastarria
data.address: José Victorino Lastarria 299, 8320144 Santiago, Región Metropolitana, Chile
data.description:
Occupying a striking contemporary building, this polished hotel is a 7-minute walk from the nearest metro station, 3 km from tours of the presidential La Moneda Palace, and 9 km from San Cristóbal Hill.
Fashionable rooms offer minibars, free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, along with glass-enclosed en suite bathrooms. Suites have sitting areas.
Complimentary amenities include parking, and a breakfast buffet served in a restaurant with panoramic city views. There's also a sophisticated tapas bar, a gym and a seasonal rooftop pool.
